title: Matcha vs Ube Food & Craft Fair
blurb: Food, desserts, drinks and a handmade market at Old Town Plaza. Free entry; vote Team Matcha or Team Ube in the free giveaway while supplies last. Pet-friendly, outdoors.

title: Elk Grove Anime World Show
blurb: Anime, cosplay, K-pop, photo ops and collectibles. Adults $15; ages 6-10 $5; ages 5 & under free; parking free.

title: Dia de los Miles 5K + Kids Fun Run
blurb: 5th annual 5K, kids' fun run and mercado benefiting the Latino Center of Art & Culture. 5K starts 8:00; kids' races (12 & under) 9:30 with finisher medals. Registration required via Race Roster; packet pick-up Sat 10/24 at Fleet Feet Elk Grove.

title: Halloween Festival at Marketplace 99
blurb: Free Halloween festival in the parking lot behind Chuck E. Cheese — face painting, balloon artist, bounce house, games and raffle. Costumes welcome; pre-registration via Eventbrite requested, walk-ups welcome. Rain or shine.

title: Hallo-Palooza and Trunk-or-Treat
blurb: City of Elk Grove's Halloween night — trunk-or-treat with the police department, DJ and bubble zone, costume contests (including pets), food vendors. No registration needed.
